en: Black‑and‑white view looking down a broad residential street lined with ornate late‑19th‑ / early‑20th‑century townhouses. The buildings have steep tiled roofs, dormers, turrets and decorative gables typical of Central European historicist architecture. A single person walks or cycles in the middle distance; there are fences, small front gardens and overhead utility wires. The sky area is blown out, giving a high‑contrast appearance. No printed caption or handwriting is visible on the image itself.
